newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast Bourse up on week in lower volume.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast Bourse up on week in lower volume.

text.p: The Ivory Coast Stock Exchange continued its upward trend this week, but saw declining volume, the market report showed.

The All-Share index, the 'BVA', rose 4.94 percent to 472.94, up from 450.69 the previous week. The blue-chip index, the '12VB', rose by 1.82 percent and closed at 326.10 after rising by 0.11 percent last Friday.
Some 16,072 shares worth 362 million CFA francs were traded compared to 66,131 shares worth 1.24 billion the previous week.
Rubber manufacturer SOGB was the most active stock with 30.58 percent of the total volume. It fell 900 CFA francs to 14,000.
The risers were led by bank BICICI BIC.CI, up 5,130 CFA francs to 55,250 CFA francs.

Other gainers were electricity utility CIE, up 1,800 CFA francs to 19,400, tarmac manufacturer SMB, up 1,480 CFA francs to 20,000, textile company UNIWAX, up 1,300 CFA francs to 79,500 and banking company SGBCI, up 1,260 CFA francs to 25,510.
The biggest loser was cable manufacturer SICABLE, down 2,200 CFA francs to 24,150.
